newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle steady, light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle steady, light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand moderate, instances light. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 75.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125 lbs ld 74.00.

Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested with few sales steady. Steers - mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs ld 120.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 108.00-109.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 112.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 98.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100 lbs ld 119.00.
